span.p:
Wallet DB
do DB, share nahi aaye
-> har kadam ka haal likho: wallet done -> portfolio done
fail pe likhe haal se retry, aage hi badho, match ke baad ulta nahi
(status log)
20k kata, phir crash -> likhe haal se retry, aage hi
retry dobara chala -> trade_id se ho chuka = no-op
match se pehle atka -> sirf tab ulta, block hatao (SAGA)
ghanton fail -> PENDING + alert, ops share daalta
